title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total actual positives. It measures how well the classifier identifies positive instances.

title: Identify True Positives
text: True positives are the cases where the prediction is $$1$$ and the true label is also $$1$$. Count these instances from the given data.

title: Identify Actual Positives
text: Actual positives are the cases where the true label is $$1$$, regardless of the prediction. Count these instances from the given data.

title: Calculate Recall
text: Use the formula for recall: true positives divided by actual positives. Calculate this using the counts from the previous hints.
